# MambaHR

> MambaHR is an autonomous AI HR department — a fully managed system that replaces your HRIS, payroll, hiring, and compliance tooling with 14 specialist agents that do the work end-to-end. One human approves the calls that matter; everything else runs itself.

## What MambaHR actually is

MambaHR is a standalone web application at app.mambahr.com. Not a Slack bot. Not a chatbot. Not an HRIS add-on. It IS the HRIS + payroll. The product handles the full HR operating surface — hiring, onboarding, payroll, leave (PTO + FMLA + state law), performance reviews, compliance, offboarding, terminations, comp adjustments — with 14 specialist agents coordinated by a single primary agent.

## Who it's for

- HR / People Ops teams at fast-growing companies (2 to 8,000+ employees)
- Heads of People, CHROs, Chief People Officers replacing legacy HRIS stacks (Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, Namely, Personio, HiBob)
- Companies that want to grow headcount without growing HR headcount

## What makes MambaHR different

- **Agents do the work, not just notify.** Where Slack-bot competitors surface a question, MambaHR's agent reads the policy, checks eligibility, drafts paperwork, files records, notifies stakeholders, and writes the audit trail. End-to-end.
- **Federal + 50-state employment law, cited on every action.** 95K lines of proprietary deterministic HR decision logic — not prompt engineering.
- **Always-you safety.** Terminations, RIFs, separation agreements, and comp changes above your threshold are always routed to a human. Never automated.
- **1–2 day setup.** Migrates from any HRIS in one day. Live the next day. No 4-to-8-week deployment.
- **One screen of policy.** Approval thresholds, leave rules, comp ranges, sign-off gates — configured on a single page. Edit anytime.

## Product surfaces

### The Today queue
The main daily workspace. Each item is a card showing what the agent decided to do, why, and (if it needs sign-off) two buttons: Approve / Decline. Cards are tagged with one of three statuses:
- **Auto-approved** — the agent handled it within policy. No human action.
- **Needs your sign-off** — judgment call inside the policy boundary. You approve or decline.
- **Always you** — high-stakes by design (terminations, RIFs, comp above threshold). Never automated.

### The 14 specialist agents
Each one owns a specific HR domain end-to-end:
1. Hiring agent — sources, screens, drafts offer letters, files I-9, orders equipment, provisions accounts
2. Onboarding agent — first-week calendars, buddy assignment, training schedules, doc collection
3. Offboarding agent — revokes access across systems, calculates final pay, drafts separation packets
4. Leave agent — PTO, parental leave, FMLA, state-specific leave (CA CFRA, NY PFL, MA PFML, etc.)
5. Payroll agent — runs payroll, reconciles, flags anomalies, files taxes, handles ACH
6. Compliance agent — answers policy questions with citations from federal + 50-state law
7. Comp agent — pulls market data, checks band rules, drafts raise recommendations
8. Performance agent — ingests goals + feedback, drafts reviews, flags outliers
9. Benefits agent — enrollments, life events, COBRA, broker coordination
10. Time agent — timesheets, overtime, scheduling, break compliance
11. Records agent — employee records, doc management, audit trail
12. Training agent — assignments, completions, mandatory state-required training
13. Investigations agent — confidential intake, documentation, escalation routing
14. Reporting agent — EEO-1, headcount, turnover, custom queries

### Sign-off model
The agent classifies every action by who decides: itself (auto), you (sign-off needed), or you only (always-you). You configure the thresholds on the policy screen. Examples:
- PTO request within policy: auto
- New hire offer above $200K: needs your sign-off
- Termination: always you
- RIF: always you

## Compliance scope

- Federal: FLSA, FMLA, ADA, ADEA, FCRA, GINA, USERRA, IRCA, EEO frameworks
- All 50 state codes + DC: labor codes, paid leave, accrual rules, final-pay timing, separation notice requirements
- Industry overlays: HIPAA-informed for healthcare customers, GDPR-compliant, CCPA/CPRA
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
- Audit log: immutable, exportable

## Migration story

MambaHR replaces your existing HRIS in a single day. Supported source systems include:
- Workday
- Rippling
- Gusto
- BambooHR
- Namely
- Personio
- HiBob
- ADP
- Paychex
- Justworks
- Trinet

What gets migrated: employees, comp records, org chart, reporting lines, leave balances, performance history, documents (offers, agreements), benefits enrollments.

Method: OAuth 2.0 connection to your source HRIS. Never stores HRIS credentials.

## Integrations

Connects to: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, AWS, GCP, Azure, DocuSign, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Notion, Linear.

## Where it does NOT replace your stack

MambaHR is the HR operating system — it doesn't replace your CRM, your engineering tools, or your finance stack (though it does replace your payroll provider since payroll is included).

## Comparison highlights

- **vs. Workday** — Workday is configuration software. MambaHR is an autonomous agent. Workday requires implementation consultants and ongoing admin teams. MambaHR sets up in a day.
- **vs. Rippling** — Rippling is a unified suite of dashboards. MambaHR is the agent that operates the suite. You don't manage workflows; the agent does.
- **vs. Gusto / BambooHR** — Built for small business. MambaHR scales the same agent across any company size with the same setup time.
- **vs. Namely / Personio / HiBob** — Same category but dashboard-first. MambaHR is action-first: agents do work, humans approve.
